messages.content: 你能告訴我克里斯蒂亞諾·羅納度在英超聯賽的曼聯俱樂部的歷史進球數，然後將其與曼聯在同一聯賽中的最佳射手進行比較，最後告訴我誰是2019-2020賽季英超聯賽的最佳射手嗎？

function.name: player_stats_get_all_time_goals
function.description: Fetch all-time goals scored by a particular football player for a specified team. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

competition.description: Competition for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is 'Premier League' if not specified.

The user asks: "Can you tell me Cristiano Ronaldo's all-time goals scored for Manchester United in the Premier League, then compare it with Manchester United's best scorer in the same league, and finally tell me who was the Premier League top scorer in the 2019-2020 season?"

We need to use the provided tools. We have:

- team_stats_get_top_scorer(team_name, competition?) -> returns top scorer for a team in a competition.

- league_stats_get_top_scorer(league_name, season?) -> returns top scorer for a league in a season.

- player_stats_get_all_time_goals(player_name, team_name, competition?) -> returns all-time goals for a player for a team in a competition.

We need to get Cristiano Ronaldo's all-time goals for Manchester United in Premier League. Then we need Manchester United's best scorer in Premier League. Then we need Premier League top scorer for 2019-2020 season.

We should call player_stats_get_all_time_goals with player_name="Cristiano Ronaldo", team_name="Manchester United", competition="Premier League". Then call team_stats_get_top_scorer with team_name="Manchester United", competition="Premier League". Then call league_stats_get_top_scorer with league_name="Premier League", season="2019-2020".

We need to do them sequentially. We'll first call player_stats_get_all_time_goals. Then after receiving result, call team_stats_get_top_scorer. Then after receiving result, call league_stats_get_top_scorer. Then combine results into a response.
